plain_statement: The edge function of the Petersen graph minus a vertex (9 inputs, 12 edges). Add two wires to the inputs: AND(x_0, x_2), and one OR gate reading any at most two of those ten wires. No circuit of at most 13 AND, OR (two-input) and NOT gates on the eleven wires computes the function.
title: A step toward: Petersen graph minus a vertex: no AND, OR (fan-in two), NOT circuit with at most 15 gates and first gate AND(x_0, x_2) computes its edge function
